features.name: age_z_clipped
features.description: Age standardized with training-fold mean and scale, then clipped to reduce leverage from extremes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear SVM a bounded, comparable age axis for stable margins.

features.name: x005_ordered_level_z_clipped
features.description: Ordered x005 level standardized with training-fold mean and scale, then clipped.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns x005 into a smooth comparable coordinate, reducing sensitivity to raw ordinal units.

features.name: hours_z_clipped
features.description: Weekly effort x013 standardized with training-fold mean and scale, then clipped.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a centered workload axis that works well with dot-product margins.

features.name: overtime_severity
features.description: Amount by which x013 exceeds 40, scaled by a 40-unit week and clipped.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates extra-hours severity from ordinary full-time variation with a bounded linear slope.

features.name: hours_age_ratio_scaled
features.description: Scaled ratio of weekly effort x013 to age x001, with a denominator floor for stability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures unusually high effort relative to age as a smooth bounded ratio.

features.name: x011_log_intensity
features.description: Log-scaled intensity of sparse amount field x011, anchored so 0 maps to 0 and the observed upper anchor maps to 1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses large sparse spikes into a near-linear bounded signal.

features.name: x012_log_intensity
features.description: Log-scaled intensity of sparse amount field x012, anchored so 0 maps to 0 and the observed upper anchor maps to 1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Keeps rare large x012 values informative without letting raw magnitude dominate.

features.name: x011_x012_log_balance
features.description: Signed difference between the bounded log intensities of x011 and x012.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a directional contrast between two sparse amount axes for a single linear weight pattern.

features.name: education_hours_age_composite
features.description: Weighted 0-to-1 composite of ordered x005 level, weekly effort x013, and proximity of x001 to a mature working-age center.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers an approximate linear projection of three related numeric dimensions into one stable margin coordinate.

features.name: x014_endpoint_code_flag
features.description: Flags endpoint code value 39 in x014, a compact indicator for a high-frequency endpoint-coded category pattern.
features.expected_model_benefit: Approximates a one-hot cue for an important coded field without expanding the schema.

features.name: coded_work_role_strength_judgment
features.description: Semantic 0-to-1 assessment of the work-role pattern using x002, x006, x007, x008, x005, and x013. A low value indicates a weak or unsettled role pattern; a high value indicates a steady, specialized, high-effort role pattern.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a compact nonlinear summary of interacting coded work and household fields that raw linear coordinates may miss.

features.name: resource_capacity_judgment
features.description: Semantic 0-to-1 assessment of overall resource capacity from x001, x005, x011, x012, and x013. A low value reflects weak ordered level, low effort, and little or adverse amount activity; a high value reflects stronger ordered level, sustained effort, and strong x011 relative to x012.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a bounded expert-style composite of advancement, effort, and sparse amount evidence for a single SVM weight.
